tools.description: Create and manage project tasks, set dependencies, assign crew, and track pre-production milestones.

actions.description: Create a new task in the EEVL Production space for each project milestone.

parameters.name: string — task name (e.g., 'Pre-Production Complete')
parameters.dependencies: array — task IDs this task depends on

actions.description: Update task status, assignees, or due dates as pre-production progresses.

parameters.custom_fields: object — key-value pairs for pillar, shoot-date, etc.

tools.description: Create the project Lark channel, add members, and post the project summary as a pinned message.

actions.description: Create a dedicated project channel named #proj-{client-slug}-{date}.

parameters.name: string — channel name following EEVL naming convention
parameters.description: string — channel purpose and project summary
parameters.members: array — Lark user IDs for crew and project manager

actions.description: Post the project summary and pin it in the channel.

parameters.pin: boolean — true to pin the message
